mesh.box: unchanged gpu_s1.box_of: s02 XY rectangle+2m, s52 GT z p5-5 to max+5; evaluation only
mesh.depth: saved pre-densification iteration7000 all training views, baseline expected depth
mesh.rgb: trained SH RGB cache, geometry independent of SH

scoring.cell: exact r2/S1 truth code mapping; no LT derived cell substitution
scoring.denominator: LT in_eval and scoring_allowed, exact centre and normal alignment required

attribution.aggregation: mean alpha-normalized rendered contribution over visible matching views
attribution.visible: positive camera depth, pixel round nearest, finite cached depth within 0.25m, alpha>1e-5
attribution.map: floating first-hit points: background-dominant mean fraction>=0.5 highlighted, missing contribution explicit
attribution.interpretation: contribution association, not a causal proof of mesh generation
